name: Emery
self_text: I’m Emery, early 20s, Indian, and I love working the city soil in my urban garden. On my PC I dive into Skyforge Arena for casual matches, always in the support slot. I chat only via text and would love someone to coach me. I’m free Saturday afternoons, and both Sunday mornings and afternoons.

requests.request_text: I need you to play a damage role or a flexible role (I can fill any position), you must be into ranked matches, I strongly prefer you to be available Saturday afternoon or Sunday afternoon or Sunday morning (though it's not a requirement), and it would be nice if you are the one who coaches me.
